title: Tacloban schools shift to morning in-person classes due to heat

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – Schools in Tacloban City have shortened classroom hours and shifted afternoon lessons to modular learning as soaring temperatures continue to pose health risks to over 55,000 students in the city’s public schools. Under adjusted class schedules this week, face-to-face classes are held only in the morning, from 7:30 a.m. to 11:45 a.m., while afternoon lessons are conducted through printed or digital learning modules. Class periods have also been reduced from the usual 45 minutes to 30 minutes, with students completing written activities at home.
